verses.text: Then Job answered:
"I have heard many things like this before. You are all terrible comforters!
Will your long-winded speeches never end? What is bothering you that you keep on arguing?
I could talk the way you do if you were in my place. I could make fine speeches against you and shake my head at you.
But I would use my words to encourage you. My comforting words would ease your pain.
If I speak, my pain does not go away. If I keep quiet, it does not leave me.
God, you have surely worn me out. You have taken away my whole family.
You have made me shrivel up, and that has become a witness against me. My thin body stands up and speaks against me.
In his anger God has torn me and attacked me. He grinds his teeth at me. My enemy stares at me with piercing eyes.
People open their mouths wide to mock me. They slap my face to shame me. They all gang up against me.
God has handed me over to evil people and thrown me into the hands of the wicked.
I was at peace, but he shattered me. He grabbed me by the neck and smashed me to pieces. He set me up as his target.
His archers surround me. Without pity he pierces my insides and spills my insides on the ground.
He breaks through my walls again and again. He charges at me like a warrior.
I have sewn sackcloth over my skin and buried my pride in the dust.
My face is red from crying, and dark shadows ring my eyes.
Yet my hands have never done violence, and my prayer is pure.
Earth, do not cover up my blood. Do not let my cry for justice be silenced.
Even now my witness is in heaven. The one who will speak for me is on high.
My friends make fun of me, while my eyes pour out tears to God.
I want someone to plead with God for me, as a person pleads for a friend.
In just a few years I will go on the road from which I will never come back.
